response.sql: SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_points_total, AVG(avg_laps) as avg_of_avg_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(CAST(points AS REAL)) as total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) as driver_stats

assumptions.assumption: "Missing values" for the laps column refers to NULL, not empty strings or other representations. AVG() will ignore NULL values per standard SQL behavior.
